classification.title: Business sector risk and complexity (IAF MD 5)
classification.hint: Suggested from the IAF codes of the scope and the sites: the highest category among the codes. Authorised users can change it with a justification.
classification.why: Suggested {{category}}: the highest category among the IAF codes, given by IAF code {{codes}} in IAF MD 5 {{table}}.
classification.energy: ISO 50001 complexity comes from energy consumption, energy types and significant energy uses (ISO 50003), not from IAF codes.
classification.noMapped: None of the IAF codes has an IAF MD 5 category: choose the category.
classification.qmsDefault: No IAF code on the scope: the Table QMS 1 time applies (medium risk).
classification.noCodes: No IAF code on the scope or the sites: choose the category.
classification.noCategoryQms: No MD 5 category; table time used
classification.noCategory: No MD 5 category; not used for the suggestion
classification.mappingConfirmed: IAF code to IAF MD 5 category mapping confirmed by the product owner on 25 October 2026.

note.MIXED: Mixed: the code covers entries of different categories. The highest non-Special one is suggested; the others are alternatives.
note.PARTIAL: Partial: the listed entry covers only part of the code.
note.INTERPRETED: Interpreted: linked by reading the code description (not named in the table).

effect.none: Choose a category to calculate the audit time.
effect.QMS_HIGH: High risk: IAF MD 5 expects more time than Table QMS 1 (Table QMS 2, Note 1). Add an increase factor with its reason (clause 8).
effect.QMS_MEDIUM: Medium risk: the Table QMS 1 time applies without a risk factor.
effect.QMS_LOW: Low risk: may need less time than Table QMS 1 (Table QMS 2, Note 1). A reduction factor is allowed within the 30 % cap (clause 8).
effect.SPECIAL: Special case: not covered by Table EMS 1. Enter the audit time developed and justified for this organisation (IAF MD 5 Annex B).
effect.ENERGY: Selects the {{category}} column of ISO 50003 Table A.3 and the surveillance and recertification times of Table A.4.
effect.COLUMN: Selects the {{category}} column of IAF MD 5 {{table}}.

override.lowered: Lowering the category is recorded with your name, the date and the justification (IAF MD 5 Annex B and Annex C).
override.notAllowed: Only the CAB administrator, the general manager, the technical manager or the certification manager can change the classification.

eligibility.title: Sampling eligibility (IAF MD 1)
eligibility.hint: Confirm each criterion. Sampling applies only when all are met; otherwise every site is audited individually (IAF MD 1 §6.2).
eligibility.notEligible: Sampling not allowed: sites audited individually

criterion.CENTRAL_FUNCTION: A central function is identified (a site is marked as central function)
criterion.SINGLE_MANAGEMENT_SYSTEM: One management system covers all sites
criterion.CENTRAL_AUTHORITY: The central function defines, establishes and maintains the system
criterion.CENTRAL_MANAGEMENT_REVIEW: The system is subject to a centralised management review
criterion.INTERNAL_AUDIT_ALL_SITES: All sites are covered by the internal audit programme
criterion.CENTRAL_DATA_ANALYSIS: The central function collects and analyses data from all sites and can initiate change
criterion.LEGAL_LINK: Every site has a legal or contractual link with the central function
criterion.SIMILAR_PROCESSES: The sites perform very similar processes and activities
criterion.NO_SCHEME_RESTRICTION: No scheme or regulatory rule requires every site to be audited
criterion.CLIENT_ACCEPTS_SAMPLING: The client has not asked for every site to be audited

options.systemEffective: System proved effective over the cycle (recertification sample 0.8√x)
options.increase: Extra sampled sites for risk (IAF MD 1 §6.1.3.5)
options.increaseReasonRequired: Give the reason (3 characters or more).

sites.title: Sites in the certification scope
sites.hint: Each site is timed from its own effective personnel. Days are recalculated whenever a site is added, removed or changed.
sites.name: Site name
sites.sameProcesses: Same processes as the other sites
sites.individualReason: Why this site is audited individually
sites.invalid: Each site needs a name and a whole number of personnel of at least 1; an individual audit needs a reason.
sites.mandatory: Mandatory in the first audit (new site)

reason.CENTRAL_FUNCTION: Central function: audited at every audit
reason.NOT_ELIGIBLE: Sampling not allowed: an IAF MD 1 criterion is not met or not confirmed
reason.HIGHER_RISK: Higher risk category than the other sites

cycle.title: Three-year certification cycle
cycle.nextRecertification: Recertification of the next cycle (information): {{days}} days

step.CLASSIFICATION_OVERRIDE: Category {{category}}: override of the suggested {{suggested}}. Justification: {{justification}}
step.SAMPLE_INCREASE: Sample increased by {{sites}} site(s) for risk: {{reason}}
step.MULTI_SITE: {{sites}} sites; sampling x = {{sampledGroup}} sites, central function included (IAF MD 1 §6.1.3.3): {{sampleInitial}} initial / {{sampleSurveillance}} surveillance / {{sampleRecertification}} recertification sites: {{days}} days
step.MULTI_SITE_GROUPS: {{sites}} sites; sampling x = {{sampledGroup}} sites, central function included (IAF MD 1 §6.1.3.3): {{sampleInitial}} initial / {{sampleSurveillance}} surveillance / {{sampleRecertification}} recertification sites; {{individualGroup}} audited individually ({{individualSurveillance}} per surveillance): {{days}} days
step.MULTI_SITE_INDIVIDUAL: {{sites}} sites, no sampling: {{individualGroup}} sites audited individually ({{individualSurveillance}} per surveillance): {{days}} days
step.RATIO: {{ratioLabel}} × {{basisDays}} days of the sites visited = {{rawDays}} → {{days}} days
step.RATIO_MIN: {{ratioLabel}} × {{basisDays}} days of the sites visited = {{rawDays}} → minimum {{minimumDays}} day → {{days}} days

warning.SAMPLING_NEEDS_CENTRAL_FUNCTION: Sampling needs a central function; every site is audited individually (IAF MD 1 §6.2).
warning.SAMPLING_NOT_ELIGIBLE: An IAF MD 1 criterion is not met or not confirmed: sites are audited individually (§6.2).
warning.CLASSIFICATION_UNVERIFIED: {{standard}}: calculated before the IAF code mapping was confirmed (25 October 2026). Recalculate to refresh.
warning.CLASSIFICATION_UNMAPPED: {{standard}}: some IAF codes have no IAF MD 5 category, so they do not set the category.
warning.QMS_HIGH_RISK_NO_INCREASE: {{standard}}: high-risk activities need more time than Table QMS 1; add an increase factor.
warning.MULTI_SITE_NOT_APPLIED_SPECIAL: {{standard}}: Special category; the individual time covers the organisation as a whole.

addSite.title: Multi-site audit time (IAF MD 1)
addSite.hint: Used by the quotation: the IAF codes suggest the risk category, and the answers below decide whether the site can be sampled or is audited individually.

recalc.title: Recalculate audit time
recalc.hint: Runs the calculation again with the current application data, sites and classification. Days changed by hand are replaced; every recalculation is recorded with the totals before and after.
recalc.locked: This quotation is issued or closed and cannot be recalculated. Cancel it and prepare a revised quotation.
recalc.notAllowed: Only the CAB administrator, the general manager, the technical manager or the certification manager can recalculate a quotation.
recalc.done: Quotation recalculated. An approved quotation goes back for approval.
